name: Cloudflare
about: Watches Cloudflare's status page; Cloudflare sits in front of all CMiC hosted environments, so its incidents can block or slow customer access to CMiC.
details: Reads Cloudflare's status page (all components). Cloudflare handles DNS, certificates and traffic for every CMiC hosted environment, so an incident in a Cloudflare service or data centre near customers can make CMiC slow or unreachable for them, even when CMiC's own servers are fine. Cloudflare reports many small, local incidents; check which locations an incident names.
label: :cloud: *Cloudflare Status*
